title: Augmented First Strike - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Augmented First Strike is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: 50% increased damage on the first hit of a battle, once per battle.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: 50% increased damage on the first hit of a battle, once per battle.

sections.title: How to Get Augmented First Strike
sections.content: Location: Defeat Francois at Esquie's Nest; Renoir's Drafts merchant.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
